system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Before each agent step, the system assembles a personalization context Cmem through two channels
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts loaded per agent/language via PromptManager plus runtime-assembled profile/RAG context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: graph traversal over G captures explicit relationships while dense search over B surfaces semantically similar content
env_context_strategy.note: Dual-index RAG (graph + embedding) injected, plus agentic tool-driven retrieval (TraceToolkit, search tools).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: hierarchical compression progressively summarizes completed sub-goals into compact digests, freeing context capacity
context_compaction.note: Also 'truncated to a context budget' for retrieved units; loop has a context-window guard.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Level 3 preserves fine-grained execution records including tool outputs, evidence, and validation outcomes
observation_format.note: Multimodal image inputs exist (prepare_multimodal_messages) but tool observations are text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Native tool calling on every cloud OpenAI-compatible provider
tool_call_format.note: DSML label/tool-call text format also used: 'Prose around a DSML tool call stops vanishing' (v1.5.11).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: AI actions can rewrite, expand, shorten, or reorganize text with optional course-material or web grounding
edit_primitive.note: Co-Writer applies actions to a selected span returned as accept/reject diff; no general file-edit tool documented in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: built-in tools, MCP servers, CLI apps, image / video / voice generation models, and installable community skills
tool_schema_source.note: MCP-sourced schemas explicit; built-in tool schema origin inferred.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: A per-account **MCP Services** store, 101 **CLI Apps** the tutor can run

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Failed pairs receive structured diagnostic feedback and are regenerated until both pedagogical and factual constraints are met.
loop_primitives.note: Default chat runs one agentic loop (react); planner produces plan P (plan_execute); Partners turn channel events into turns (event_driven).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: it produces a tutoring plan P=⟨s 1,...,s K⟩ of concrete, annotated sub-goals

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: decomposes it into research directions, dispatches research agents over course materials, web sources, academic-paper search, and computational tools
multi_agent_topology.note: Specialized memory agents, planner/solver/writer, generator/validator; subagent consultation optional.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the tutor runs a bounded number of consults, treats the returned work as evidence, and then answers in its own voice
delegation_mechanism.note: consult_subagent tool; user must connect an external agent harness.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a cost estimate before you approve a spine
human_in_loop.note: Book spine approval (on_plan), Co-Writer accept/reject diffs (on_completion); MCP tools deny-by-default for non-admins is configurable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each Partner maintains its own workspace, conversation state, persona specification, skill set, and long-term memory
short_term_state.note: Plan object, self-notes scratchpad, and trace nodes beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Every node carries a dense embedding, enabling similarity-based retrieval across the entire forest.
long_term_memory.note: Trace Forest = episodic store with embeddings; installable skills from EduHub/ClawHub; notebooks/Co-Writer drafts as file notes.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Partner conversations gain branch / resume / delete with a replayable trace
state_persistence.note: Also 'restart-safe turn runtime' (v1.4.0) and session persistence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: LLM-based verification assesses template alignment, factual correctness, and pedagogical soundness for all items, while computational questions undergo additional sandboxed code execution
self_verification.note: Writer's successive refinement passes = self_critique; evaluator-driven filtering = llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Failed pairs receive structured diagnostic feedback and are regenerated until both pedagogical and factual constraints are met.
retry_policy.note: Applies to question generation; chat turns are single-attempt.

rollback.evidence_quote: each action is applied to a selected span and returned as an accept/reject diff, the learner controls what lands in the document
rollback.note: Only user-level accept/reject of edits; no agent rollback/undo mechanism found in evidence.

termination_condition.note: Terminal labels = model_declared; context-window guard and per-stage token limits.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Per-stage token limits, Regenerate response across all entry points
cost_controls.note: 'bounded LLM client and index caches' (v1.5.8); per-agent model selection in agents.yaml / catalog.

timeouts.evidence_quote: book creation no longer times out
timeouts.note: Timeouts referenced only in release notes; per-tool timeout not visible in supplied evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: TutorBot tool sandbox locked down, per-user resource isolation
execution_isolation.note: Runs as a local FastAPI+Next.js app; Docker image is an alternative deployment of the whole app.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Optional multi-user deployments with isolated user workspaces, admin grants, auth routes, and scoped runtime access.
filesystem_access.note: Per-user workspace under data/; 'credentials moved out of the sandbox's reach' (v1.5.7).

network_policy.evidence_quote: dispatches research agents over course materials, web sources, academic-paper search, and computational tools
network_policy.note: No egress restriction mechanism appears in the evidence; web search and MCP calls are unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: deny-by-default MCP tools for non-admin users
permission_model.note: Per-user tool grants; also 'Install community skills ... behind a security gate'.

tracing.evidence_quote: Level 3 preserves fine-grained execution records including tool outputs, evidence, and validation outcomes
tracing.note: Trace Forest plus loop iteration trace metadata; no OTEL found in evidence.

replayability.evidence_quote: Partner conversations gain branch / resume / delete with a replayable trace

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we introduce TutorBench, an interactive benchmark incorporating customized learner profiles grounded in university-level curricula across five domains
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark is described in the paper; presence of an evaluation runner in the pinned repo is not shown in the supplied files.

guardrails.evidence_quote: credentials moved out of the sandbox's reach
guardrails.note: 'safer reading citations', 'deny-by-default MCP tools', 'security gate' for skill install; validator checks outputs.

target_domain.evidence_quote: DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, problem solving, quiz generation, research, visualization, and mastery practice in one extensible system.
target_domain.note: Primary domain is education/tutoring (coded 'other'); Deep Research and MCP/CLI tool use also shipped.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Multi-provider LLM & embedding support, new home page, RAG module decoupling, and environment variable refactor.
model_agnostic.note: Native OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs (litellm dropped in v1.0.0-beta.3) plus OpenAI-compatible gateways.

first_release_date.note: Earliest release listed in README; earlier tags may exist (project released 2025-12-29 per News).
